method: Historical mechanical brown-trout replay using Manistee River near Wellston, MI — below Tippy Dam USGS 04125550 daily mean discharge, Manistee River near Wellston, MI — measured water temperature USGS 04125550 daily mean measured water temperature, and each four-hour block's Open-Meteo radiation, cloud cover, and precipitation. The read is scoped to The measured conditions represent the Wellston/Tippy tailwater in the Upper river. Migratory Brown Trout can be distributed elsewhere below Tippy Dam, where temperature, clarity, and presentation conditions can differ. It validates scoring behavior and copy, not catch rates.
